captions.detailed: A retro-style shoulder mini camcorder with a matte black finish. It features a main rectangular body with rounded edges, a cylindrical lens assembly protruding from the front, a rounded battery bulge at the rear, a top carrying handle, and a gray selector dial. On its left side, a rectangular LCD screen panel is recessed into the housing, situated above a horizontal tape-compartment door.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a shoulder-style mini camcorder with a dark matte body and a gray top selector dial. Ensure it features a front cylindrical lens, a top handle, a rear battery bulge, an articulated side LCD panel that swings open vertically, and a tape-compartment door that rotates downwards.
captions.factory: Construct the main camera body using a filleted box primitive, then subtract a side cavity for the display and tape deck. Model the battery bulge using a filleted box on the rear, and the lens assembly using stepped cylinders on the front. Extrude a T-shaped profile for the top handle, and create a fluted cylinder for the selector dial. Define the LCD panel and tape door as separate parts, placing their revolute joints at their respective vertical and horizontal hinge axes.
